`senior-engineer` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Provides the default engineering discipline for repository work: evidence-first investigation, architecture judgment, test-first implementation, focused validation, review, and safe publishing.

## When to use it

Use this skill for any coding, debugging, refactoring, architecture, validation, or task in the repository. This skill is the default engineering mode. Invoke it whenever the assistant is expected to read code, change code, diagnose a bug, design an implementation plan, review a diff, run tests, validate behavior, or prepare a PR.

Typical requests include:

- “Debug this regression and ship a focused fix.”
- “Review this implementation and validate the behavior.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill senior-engineer
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill senior-engineer
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/senior-engineer/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

Senior Engineer owns engineering judgment. Task Workflow owns task lifecycle and Branch Planner owns multi-PR decomposition.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/senior-engineer/SKILL.md` exists and that `senior-engineer` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `senior-engineer` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
